fullDescription: A dark glassmorphism SaaS pricing page on a violet-pink-cyan aurora gradient, with frosted plan cards, a featured tier, a monthly/annual toggle, and an FAQ accordion.
prompt:
## Resumo
A frosted-glass, dark-aurora SaaS pricing page: a sticky blurred nav, a centered hero with a gradient headline and a monthly/annual billing toggle, then three glassmorphic plan cards (Starter / Pro-featured / Team) that reflow from a 3-column grid down to 2 and then 1 column, finished with an FAQ accordion, a glowing mini-CTA, and a slim footer. The whole page floats on a soft multi-color aurora gradient with film grain.

## Estilo Visual
Build a premium dark glassmorphism aesthetic. Page background is a layered aurora: near-black base linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0814 -> #0b0913 -> #08070f) over the body color #07060d, with stacked radial-gradient blooms in rgba(140,122,255,0.46) (violet, top-left), rgba(255,124,192,0.34) (pink, top-right), rgba(96,206,255,0.16) (cyan, mid-right) and rgba(96,196,255,0.20) (cyan, bottom). Overlay a faint SVG fractal-noise grain (~3.5% opacity, mix-blend overlay). Cards are frosted glass: background linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.085), rgba(255,255,255,0.025)), backdrop-filter blur(26px) saturate(135%), 1px border rgba(255,255,255,0.12), shadow 0 30px 70px -28px rgba(0,0,0,0.65) plus inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16). A lighter 'glass-soft' variant (blur 18px, border rgba(255,255,255,0.09)) is used for pills, the toggle, FAQ rows and secondary buttons. Signature accent gradient: linear-gradient(100deg, #8b7bff -> #c47bff 55% -> #ff8fc4) for primary buttons and the logo mark; a text gradient linear-gradient(98deg, #d9d2ff -> #f0a6d8 48% -> #9fd9ff) for the headline; a price gradient linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff -> #c9c1f5). Accent tints: violet #b9a8ff / #c9b6ff, lilac #d6c8ff / #e3d4ff, pink #f0a6d8, cyan #9fd9ff; check icons #b9a8ff. Text: white headings, body in slate-300 at ~85% opacity, muted meta in slate-400/500. Fonts: 'Sora' (700/800) for the display headline, plan names, prices and section titles; 'Inter' (400-600) for body and UI. Tight tracking on display type, generous line-height on body. Rounded-3xl cards, rounded-xl/rounded-full buttons, soft hover lift (translateY -6px) on cards.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Fixed top-0 full-width header with a frosted bar: background rgba(10,8,18,0.55), backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(140%), 1px bottom border rgba(255,255,255,0.07). Inside, a max-w-6xl row (h-16, px-6) with: left, a gradient-glow rounded square logo mark (sparkle icon) + 'Prismatic' wordmark in Sora 700; center (hidden on mobile), nav links Library / Templates / Pricing (active, white) / FAQ in 14px slate-300; right, a ghost 'Sign in' text link and a glass-soft pill 'Start free' button.

### Hero / headline
Centered hero inside the full-bleed aurora section (max-w-2xl, pt-32 pb-24). Top: a small glass-soft pill with a lightning icon reading '12,000+ ready-to-ship UI prompts'. Then a two-line Sora 800 H1 'Design at the / speed of thought' where the second line uses the violet->pink->cyan text gradient, ~40px mobile scaling to ~54px desktop, leading ~1.05. Below, a 15-16px slate-300 subparagraph (max-w-xl) describing a living library of production-grade UI prompts on an infinite canvas.

### Billing toggle
Centered inline-flex below the hero: a 'Monthly' label (white when active), a custom pill switch (glass-soft track ~52px wide, 7 high, with a gradient-glow knob that slides translateX(24px) on toggle), an 'Annual' label (slate-400 when inactive), and a 'Save 20%' badge in a violet-tinted pill (#b9a8ff bg at 15%, #d6c8ff text, #b9a8ff/25 border). Wire JS so flipping it swaps each card's price (data-m vs data-a values) and updates the billing note text (Billed monthly/yearly, Per editor...).

### Pricing cards (centerpiece)
A responsive pricing grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3, gap-6, items-stretch. Three tiers, each a rounded-3xl glass card (p-7, flex column, hover lift): (1) STARTER — cyan paint-brush icon tile, 'For solo makers', price $0 /forever, 'No card required', 4 check-list features (30 generations/month, browse full prompt library, 1 infinite canvas, export to React & HTML), glass-soft 'Get started' button. (2) PRO — the FEATURED card: violet/pink tinted 'featured' background with a glowing gradient ring (::after mask border) and a soft violet glow orb behind it, slightly scaled up (lg:scale-1.04) and lifted (-mt-3), an absolutely-positioned 'MOST POPULAR' gradient pill on the top edge, magic-wand icon tile, 'For shipping designers', price $24 /month, 'Billed monthly', 5 features (unlimited generations, premium & pro-only prompt packs, unlimited canvases & versions, coding-agent skill Claude/Cursor, Figma & code export), gradient-glow 'Start 14-day trial' button. (3) TEAM — pink users icon tile, 'For product squads', price $69 /month, 'Per editor, billed monthly', 5 features (Everything in Pro, shared team libraries, roles/SSO/brand kits, priority generation queue, dedicated success manager), glass-soft 'Talk to sales' button. All prices use the white->lilac price gradient in Sora 800; each feature row is a check-circle icon in #b9a8ff + 14px slate text.

### Trust strip
Below the cards, a centered wrap-flex row of three small 13px slate-400 trust items, each with a tinted icon: 'SOC 2 secured' (cyan lock), 'Cancel anytime' (violet refresh arrow), 'No setup fees' (pink credit-card).

### FAQ accordion
A new darker section (bg #08070f, top hairline border) with a max-w-3xl column (py-20). Centered Sora 800 heading 'Questions, answered' + slate-400 subline. Then a stack of native <details> accordion rows styled as rounded-2xl glass-soft cards (p-5): each summary is a 15.5px white question with a caret-down icon that rotates 180deg when open; the first row open by default. Four Q&As: what counts as a generation, can I switch plans later, do prompts work with my coding agent (Claude Code/Cursor), is there a free option.

### Mini-CTA + footer
After the FAQ, a centered rounded-3xl glass CTA card (p-9) with a soft violet radial glow bleeding from the top edge: Sora 800 heading 'Start designing in the next minute', a slate-400 supporting line, and a gradient-glow pill button 'Create your first design' with a rocket icon. Then a slim footer (top hairline border, max-w-6xl, py-8): logo mark + 'Prismatic' on the left, a centered copyright line, and X / GitHub / Discord icon links on the right.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Frosted glass card — The repeating translucent card used for plans, FAQ rows, pills and the CTA box. Reads as real frosted glass over the colorful aurora.
Compose with a 165deg white-on-white translucent gradient fill, a strong backdrop blur+saturate, a 1px white hairline border at ~12% opacity, a deep ambient drop shadow plus an inset top highlight (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16)). Provide a softer variant (less blur, fainter fill/border) for smaller surfaces like pills, the toggle, FAQ rows and ghost buttons.

### Featured plan glow — The middle (Pro) card's premium treatment: a tinted glass fill, a bright gradient ring outline, an exterior color glow, and a blurred orb behind it.
Give the featured card a violet/pink tinted background gradient, a luminous gradient border created with an ::after pseudo-element using padding + mask-composite to draw a 1px ring (linear-gradient from #c4b0ff -> #ff96cd -> transparent), and a layered box-shadow that throws ~80px of violet glow outward. Add an absolutely-positioned blurred radial 'orb' (filter blur ~46px, violet) behind it, scale the card up ~4% and pull it up slightly, and pin a gradient 'MOST POPULAR' pill on its top edge.

### Billing toggle (monthly/annual) — Custom pill switch with a gradient knob that swaps all card prices and billing notes via JS.
Build an accessible role='switch' button as a glass-soft pill track with an absolutely-positioned gradient-glow knob. On click flip an `annual` flag and re-render: read data-m / data-a price attributes on each price element to swap the displayed price, update each card's billing-note text, recolor the active Monthly/Annual labels, slide the knob translateX(24px), and set aria-checked.

### Gradient-glow primary button — The signature CTA button reused in nav logo, featured plan, hero pill knob and CTA card.
Create a pill/rounded button filled with linear-gradient(100deg, #8b7bff -> #c47bff 55% -> #ff8fc4), an inset top white highlight and a soft colored drop shadow (0 14px 34px -10px rgba(150,110,255,0.7)); brighten ~8% on hover. Use the same gradient for the small logo mark and the toggle knob to tie the system together.

### Aurora + grain backdrop — The full-bleed multi-color gradient field that the whole hero/pricing section floats on.
Layer several large radial-gradient blooms (violet top-left, pink top-right, cyan mid and bottom) over a dark vertical base gradient, then overlay a faint inline-SVG fractal-noise texture (~3.5% opacity, mix-blend-mode overlay) so the gradient reads as soft film grain rather than a flat wash.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive web page (not a fixed-size artboard). Key responsive behavior: the pricing grid reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 column (lg -> md -> mobile) and the featured-card scale/lift + glow orb only apply at lg; the nav stays sticky/frosted while the aurora scrolls beneath it, and the center nav links collapse on mobile. Dark mode only (color-scheme: dark). Built with Tailwind (CDN) + custom CSS for glass/aurora/glow, Sora + Inter from Google Fonts, and Iconify Phosphor icons; the only JS is the billing toggle. To rebrand, keep the glass + aurora system and swap the violet->pink->cyan accent ramp and the plan copy.

Near-black violet base, frosted translucent cards with white hairline borders and inner highlights, and a violet -> pink -> cyan accent gradient that recurs across the headline, prices, primary buttons, and the featured-plan glow. Subtle film grain over everything keeps the glass from looking flat.
